## Activity

During December 2022, River Outreach completed 43 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The capture total is reported as received from the site, with no further interpretation applied in this summary.

## Image quality

Of the 43 captures, 7 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 16.3. These images could not proceed through grading and are reported separately from the graded results. The site also reported no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This measure is presented alongside the referable result count to provide a concise view of grading activity for December 2022. The figures above describe the recorded activity at River Outreach and distinguish capture volume, image quality, and grading outcomes.
